---
title: "simstim host alerts log"
---

<!-- Generated by `just docs` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Show the host's last alert deliveries, and why any were not sent.

```text
simstim host alerts log <host> [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--json` | print JSON |
| `-n`, `--lines <int>` | how many lines to show (default: `20`) |

Part of [`host alerts`](host_alerts.md): show where a host sends alerts about its sessions, and the last deliveries.
